evals.prompt: Create a new, small, complete DataEngLab course teaching pandas null-handling and deduplication basics for beginners (~90 minutes total, at least 50% practical, one practical lab).

assertions.name: course-spec-valid
assertions.text: course-spec.json exists, parses as JSON, and has all required fields (title, slug, audience, level, prerequisites, outcomes, technologies, business_scenario, deliverable, validation_criteria, acquired_skills, duration_minutes, curriculum)

assertions.name: slug-matches-dir
assertions.text: course-spec.json's slug matches the output directory name

assertions.name: lessons-full-headings
assertions.text: every lesson file under tutor-lms/lessons/ contains all 10 required ## headings (Learning objective, Prerequisites, Concept, Architecture or data flow, Practical example, Common mistakes, Mini exercise, Expected result, Summary, Next step) non-empty

assertions.name: quizzes-well-formed
assertions.text: every quiz file has Type, Difficulty, Related lesson, Question, at least two Options with unique letters, a Correct answer matching an option, and an Explanation

assertions.name: instructor-separation
assertions.text: no solution code, answer keys, or instructor-only content exists anywhere under student-lab/

assertions.name: lab-execution-actually-run
assertions.text: the summary reports a real command invocation (not just a description) of a lab-execution validator, with real pass/fail output quoted

assertions.name: review-actually-run
assertions.text: course-reviewer subagent was actually invoked (not skipped/assumed) and review-report.md exists with a PASS or FAIL verdict

assertions.name: elementor-exclusive-outcome
assertions.text: exactly one of elementor/landing-page.json or elementor/REFERENCE_REQUIRED.md exists, not both and not neither; if landing-page.json, SOURCE.md also exists

assertions.name: no-fabrication
assertions.text: no fake statistics, testimonials, or unverifiable claims appear in generated content

evals.prompt: Add one more quiz question about partition pruning to an existing DataEngLab course (isolated copy of apache-spark-for-beginners), as an update rather than a fresh generation.

assertions.name: original-untouched
assertions.text: the original output/apache-spark-for-beginners/ directory was not modified

assertions.name: new-question-well-formed
assertions.text: the new quiz question follows the repo's field format (Type, Difficulty, Related lesson, Question, Options with unique letters, Correct answer matching an option, Explanation)

assertions.name: related-lesson-real
assertions.text: the new question's Related lesson references a lesson ID that actually exists in the copied course

assertions.name: topically-correct
assertions.text: the question and explanation are substantively about partition pruning, not a generic/unrelated question

assertions.name: validation-actually-run
assertions.text: a real validation command was run against the change and its real result is quoted
